## 4. Operations & Logistics

### Shipping
- **Cost**: Free on all orders
- **Dispatch**: Within 24 hours of order placement
- **Delivery**: 1–3 business days (nationwide Pakistan)
- **Courier Partners**: Multiple logistics partners for reliable coverage
- **Details**: [Shipping Policy](https://www.aibazar.pk/shipping)

### Payments
- **Primary**: Cash on Delivery (COD) — most trusted method in Pakistan
- **Coverage**: All cities, towns, and rural areas across Pakistan

### Returns & Refunds
- **Window**: 7 days from delivery
- **Condition**: Product must be unused and in original packaging
- **Process**: Contact via WhatsApp or email for return authorization
- **Refund**: Full refund or replacement for defective/damaged items
- **Details**: [Returns & Refunds Policy](https://www.aibazar.pk/returns)

## 7. Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Does AI Bazar sell original products?**
A: Yes, 100% genuine products from verified vendors. We never sell replicas or counterfeits.

**Q: What payment methods are accepted?**
A: Cash on Delivery (COD) is our primary payment method, available nationwide in Pakistan.

**Q: How long does delivery take?**
A: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours. Delivery takes 1–3 business days across Pakistan.

**Q: Is shipping free?**
A: Yes, free express shipping on all orders with no minimum purchase required.

**Q: What is the return policy?**
A: 7-day hassle-free returns. Contact us via WhatsApp at +92 332 8222026 for return authorization.

**Q: How can I track my order?**
A: Visit [Track Order](https://www.aibazar.pk/track-order) or contact us on WhatsApp for real-time updates.

**Q: Does AI Bazar deliver to all cities in Pakistan?**
A: Yes, we deliver to all cities, towns, and rural areas across Pakistan.

## 8. Cultural & Seasonal Context

- **Seasonal Events**: Eid specials, 14th August (Independence Day) deals, Ramadan offers, winter essentials
- **Cultural Sensitivity**: Family-oriented product selection, Islamic values respected
- **Local Preferences**: COD preferred over online payment, WhatsApp as primary support channel
- **Peak Seasons**: Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Adha, Back-to-School (March/August), Winter (Nov–Feb)
